decisions.statement: The editor calls one function to start everything.
Every panel is named here with the start that brings that panel up.
Every start runs to one deadline.
One bun process answers this window apart from any other window's process.
The command server is heard before any panel starts.
A window closing while starting takes its command server with that window.
The server's own stdin closing reaps that server where this host is killed.
The observation store is named for the window's own process.
The store is handed the host's own fetch, and writes nowhere without one.
The store is dropped when the editor stops.
Each start's outcome is recorded as an observation under the panel's name.
A panel that did not start is named to Alan once.
The rest of the panels are said to be running.
Nothing here knows the contents a panel draws.
Nothing runs when the editor stops.

definition: what the editor calls to start the panels, and what each start is recorded as
